ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 14, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Barbara A. Pollack, Chair  Margo Morales, Commissioner
Chief Coleman, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Susan Wise, Commissioner
Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54514  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meeting of
  Wednesday, July 10, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54515  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation providing an update for the
  Public Records Act Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54516  Recommendation to receive and file Conflict of Interest amendments from the
  Office of the City Clerk in preparation for the upcoming 2024 Biennial Review.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54517  Recommendation to authorize the Chair and Vice Chair to collaborate with LBTV on
  creating a PSA to be distributed through Channel 8, employee and public
  newsletters, and neighborhood association email lists.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54518  Recommendation to provide feedback to the Ad Hoc Committee on Updated
  Policies regarding the draft Ethics Ordinance proposed to date.

  Page 1 of 4
   ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 14, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-54519  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Ad Hoc Committee on
  Updated Policies regarding Chapter 4.07 (“Political Activities”) and Chapter 4.08
  (“Ex Parte Contacts and Fair Hearings”) of the draft Ethics Ordinance.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-54520  Recommendation to discuss and take action on draft recommendations from the Ad
  Hoc Committee on the Lobbyist Ordinance (Ad Hoc) for changes to the City’s
  current lobbyist ordinance; and, if appropriate, authorize the Ad Hoc to meet with
  the Mayor and City Councilmembers on behalf of the Commission and appear at
  any future council meetings in which the proposal is presented and discussed.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  24-54521  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Ad Hoc on the Authority of
  the Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  24-54522  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Ad Hoc Committee on the
  2024 PNE (Primary Nominating Election) Candidate Filings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 24-54523  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects;
  and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve, create or reauthorize Ad Hoc
  Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 24-54524  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 24-54525  Recommendation to discuss potential agenda items for future Commission
  meetings.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
